recommendation: Keep the commit unless FHIR-I later resolves FHIR-56020 or a similar issue to revise or remove these binding purposes; until then, R6 source should reflect the Applied FHIR-50893 decision.
issue_request: FHIR-50893 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and requested adding current-extensible, updating current, adding best-practice, and adding an abstract open grouping concept for additional binding purposes after TI discussion.
initial_application: Git commit 8684e35f85 added current-extensible, best-practice, and open to source/datatypes/codesystem-additional-binding-purpose.xml and nested preferred/ui/starter/component under open. Commit fe420c6da2 later updated ElementDefinition.binding.additional.purpose's fixed code list to include current-extensible and best-practice. The code system still retained old or weaker wording for current/current-extensible/open and left candidate outside open.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps datatypes and ElementDefinition, and ElementDefinition binds AdditionalBindingPurpose to valueset-additional-binding-purpose, which includes the edited code system. May 2025 VOC and FHIR-I minutes support the hierarchy and FHIR-I approval. FHIR-56020 is a later Submitted/unresolved challenge to some of these codes and does not supersede the Applied decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/codesystem-additional-binding-purpose.xml to use the approved current and current-extensible definitions, use the approved open grouper definition, and move candidate under open with the other non-formal-conformance purpose codes.
